usageNotes: Triggers an `apt-get update` on the specified PDM node to refresh the local package index; run this before querying available upgrades or installing packages. The operation is asynchronous — the response is a UPID string that should be polled via the task API to confirm completion. Requires `System.Modify` privilege; the node must be online and reachable.

examples.summary: Refresh APT package index on node 'pdm01' with email notification enabled

tips: Poll the returned UPID using the task-status endpoint to know when the update completes before acting on package data.
Set quiet=true in automated/cron contexts to suppress progress output and produce cleaner logs.
notify=true sends mail only to the address configured for root@pam on the PDM instance — verify that address is set before relying on it.
